Initial release of fetch-archive: a universal tool for fetching and archiving articles, audio, and video to structured Markdown and 乐享知识库.

- Supports full-content extraction from any URL, including paywalled and login-protected articles (Substack, Medium, Knowledge Planet, etc.), with structured Markdown and images.
- Handles YouTube and podcast audio: download (yt-dlp), transcribe (Whisper), and translate to bilingual Markdown, then upload both text and media to 乐享.
- Features dedicated workflows and selector optimizations for platforms like 微信公众号 and Substack, including robust login/cookie management (Cookie/CDP modes).
- Ensures output uses the original article/video title as the filename and document title, with automatic sanitization for illegal characters.
- Provides structured metadata JSON for each entry (URL, title, author, date, etc.), and organizes all assets for streamlined archiving and retrieval in 乐享.
- Includes clear differentiation and workflow guidance between `fetch_article.py` and `web_fetch` based on content type and completeness.
